[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 11 October 2026.

[2026-10-11_HBAR]  
Video Title: Hedera $HBAR Analysis 📊  
Video ID: LiXOrMaacKk  
Hedera (HBAR) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
The current trading price sits at approximately 11.3¢, a 6 % discount to the 12¢ time‑weighted average price. The 20‑day SMA has deviated by roughly 9¢ from the price, indicating a modest pullback from a recent breakout. Composite risk is measured at 31 with raw gravity at 5.5, placing HBAR in the lower‑risk quadrant of the top‑20 crypto cohort. Social sentiment remains bullish, reflected in a word‑cloud dominated by “breakout,” “accumulation,” and “bull expansion.”  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
TWAP baselines are anchored at the 12¢ average, with a current TWAP risk level of 33 after a recent pullback from a peak of 46. Regression fair‑value bands show HBAR trading near the channel’s midpoint, suggesting neither over‑valuation nor under‑valuation at present. The residual zone indicates a potential upside of up to 51 % (≈36¢ target) before the next cycle phase, while a 24 % discount to the time‑average signals a possible undervaluation window.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
Machine‑learning forecasts project a 10‑week bearish floor between 4¢ and 5.4¢, with a non‑panic support floor near 3¢ and a panic floor close to 5¢. Macro moving‑average supports include the 20‑day SMA at 9¢ and the 90‑day SMA near 12¢. Cycle‑based bull targets point to a 2027 altcoin season, with a stretch goal of approximately 96¢ (≈10.5× the current price) if the next expansion phase fully materializes.
